config.letterTitle: To the girl who is made my world full of colours,
config.letterBody:
Happy Birthday, my Silly Sara! 🌸

From the moment you came into my life, everything became softer, sweeter, and incredibely more colorful. You have this magical way of making simple Goodnight and Good Morning feel special.

Thank you for your warm giggles, your gentle heart, the way your eyes crinkle when you truly laugh, and the quiet but kind personality. Being your 'Beloved' is the highest honor that I can get.

I built this little website just for you for a celebration of your special day, every memory we've made for 3 years, and the endless adventures still waiting for us ahead.

May this year, this new age bring you as much fortune and happiness as you effortlessly bring into my life every single day.
config.letterSignoff:
Your first and your last,
With all my love Tamir❤️
